_readme: Schedule for the Creator Carnival. Edit this file and redeploy — no code changes needed. Times are 24h wall-clock at the venue (America/New_York). The exhibitor list is NOT here: it is generated from real booth signups in ccc_booth_signups.

schedule.title: Creator Early Access
schedule.description: Invited creators get first access to the marketplace floor. Sample collection begins — VIP ticket holders get guaranteed samples from every brand before general doors open.

schedule.title: General Admission Opens
schedule.description: Doors open to the public. The full marketplace, carnival activations, and stage programming are live for all ticket holders.

schedule.title: Brand Marketplace, Booths & Activations
schedule.description: 100+ brand booths, the Capital Wheel, caricature art, creator photo booths, branded activations, and live music running throughout the day. Walk, film, shop, connect.

schedule.title: Main Stage — Presentations, Demos & Performances
schedule.description: Live-streamed stage programming throughout the day. Creator showcases, brand spotlights, live shopping demos, and performances broadcast well beyond the crowd on the ground.

schedule.title: VIP on the Belvedere
schedule.description: Top creators and VIP guests get guaranteed access to the Belvedere — National Harbor's elevated waterfront space with views of the Potomac.

schedule.title: VIP After-Party — Felt Lounge at MGM National Harbor
schedule.description: The night continues at the Felt Lounge inside MGM National Harbor. Exclusive access for VIP ticket holders. The official Creator Carnival after-party.
